comparison.engines: bare pi-agent-core Agent (current engine construction) vs hermetic SDK AgentSession

providerPath.note: the engines reach the loopback through different pi-ai provider registrations and stream options; every request is checked against the same credential, tool schema and literal transcript, so the wire contract matches but provider-side request shaping does not

script: openai-completions loopback; twoIndependentRuns builds a fresh instance per tool+text run, the diagnostic instance runs two turns then aborts a held stream

metricScope.process: all engine metrics run in one process after module import and an untimed warmup trial per engine; they are not cold boot
metricScope.twoIndependentRuns: primary: construction plus one tool+text run on each of two fresh instances, through settlement; budget sdk median <= 1.2x agent median
metricScope.abort: held stream abort through settlement; criterion every sample under 5000 ms
metricScope.firstRun: diagnostic: first run on the diagnostic instance
metricScope.warmRun: diagnostic: warm second turn on the same instance, not a product per-run benchmark

coldImport.scope: fresh Node process per sample, import only; module sets differ in capability, so no ratio or verdict

hostContext.serialization: all task-owned unit, integration and web processes had exited before this run
hostContext.backgroundLoad: system indexing, virtual-machine and graphical processes remained active; not stopped by this task
hostContext.ordering: 30 pairs, A/B then B/A alternated; one untimed warmup per engine
hostContext.limits: host scheduling noise remains; ranges are reported, no tolerance floor or artificial latency added

interpretation.rawBudget: over; proposed 1.2x bound is not met on this synthetic composite
interpretation.productPerformance: inconclusive; distinct provider registration/stream settings and no full executor or real inference latency
interpretation.profile: a separate 5-pair CPU-profile run was excluded from reported samples; 2.619 s total, 1.817 s idle, 104.5 ms module compilation; model catalog merge sampled 10.1 ms and session projection/loadout around 1.2 ms each. It includes imports and child-process waits and does not identify a causal steady-state limiter for the primary metric. Raw profile stays private because it contains local paths.
interpretation.decision: do not claim a product regression or accept migration on this ratio; profile equivalent provider paths and full executor before relaxing the gate
interpretation.abort: all observed held-stream abort samples under 5000 ms; a timeout would fail the command and make the gate inconclusive, not a passing sample
